oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deployment 'canary/2026-03-15/slot-9' detected healthcheck failures in region us-west-2. Abort criteria triggered (5xx rate > 3% over 1m). Paging on-call.
Evan: I'm on it, seeing alerts in Datadog for /generate endpoint — 5xx spike ~3.8% and p95 latency doubled. Pulling logs now.
Priya: I got the page, taking ownership. @Evan what's the canary config? any new feature flags? :eyes:
Evan: Canary is the new routing guard (feature flag: routing_v2) rolled to 10% canary instances. ReleaseBot started canary at 14:02 UTC per deploy log.
ReleaseBot: deploy canary/2026-03-15/slot-9 started by marina at 14:02:11 UTC. Target instances: 20 -> 2 canaries. Healthcheck window: 60s.
Priya: I can repro 502s in the canary logs. Paste of recent stack traces:
```
[2026-03-15T14:03:05Z] upstream response null -> 502
... kv-cache miss -> fallback route triggered
Error: InvalidRoutingState at router.go:412
```
Evan: That looks like the new router path hitting a codepath that returns upstream errors when cache miss + short-circuit.
SRE-Triage: Confirming metrics: source=api, path=/generate, region=us-west-2, 1m_5xx=3.8%, baseline=0.4%.
Priya: Abort criteria met. Steps: 1) Flip feature flag routing_v2 -> off for canaries (kill-switch). 2) Stop further canary progression. 3) Rollback if errors persist. I'll flip the flag now.
Priya: /feature-flag set routing_v2=false --scope=canary --env=prod
Priya: Flag change acknowledged by feature service (eid=ff-9876). Rolling back traffic step paused.
Marina: Confirmed on the deploy dashboard that canary progression halted. :white_check_mark:
Priya: I'm monitoring logs; 5xx rate returning to baseline in the last 30s. p95 latency improving.
Evan: Any customer-facing impact? CS reported two customers in us-west had transient failures in chat sessions.
Priya: From request tracing, impacted trace count ~120 requests in 2 minutes, top customers with errors: cust-42, cust-314. Notified support to message SLAs. Impact window ~14:02:30-14:04:20 UTC.
Jordan: I'm taking notes for postmortem. Priya, do you want to hand off continuous monitoring to me while you run a deeper root cause? I'll own the incident doc and follow-ups.
Priya: Yep handing off to @Jordan for follow-up. I'm going to diff the router code and KV cache interactions. @Evan you can help validate a unit test for the cache miss path.
Jordan: Taking on-call handoff for follow-up. Next steps I'm tracking: 1) Confirm rollback unnecessary if flag flip suffices. 2) Validate new unit/integration tests added before next canary. 3) Incident ticket and severity classification.
Evan: I'll prep a small test and run it against the staging router with simulated cache miss.
ReleaseBot: Canary halted. No further canary redeploys scheduled. operator=Priya. event_id=evt-20260315-cc9.
Marina: FYI, I've notified product and support via #customer-impact with a short blurb. Support will reach out only to high-touch customers.
Priya: Logging this under incident-triage/1740539999 and assigning sev=2 until we validate there's no regression.
Jordan: I'll create the incident ticket and postmortem template. Assigning action items: Evan test (owner=Evan), Add FF kill-switch docs (owner=Marina), Add regression tests (owner=Priya). ETA for follow-ups: 48h.
Evan: Confirmed local repro steps and a failing test. Will open PR with fix + tests.
Priya: Thanks all. Handing off monitoring to @Jordan. If 5xx creeps up again, re-escalate paging and we'll trigger rollback.
Jordan: Taking it. Closing this thread for live mitigation — keeping incident active in tracker. :lock_with_ink_pen:
oncall-bot: Note: thread closed for live mitigation by Jordan at 14:07:30 UTC. If new alerts appear, this thread will re-open and page the on-call group.
